children: Shares of Titan Company climbed as much as 2.46 per cent to ₹4,953.70 on Friday afternoon trade, touching an intraday high of ₹5,003.90, as investors reacted to the jewellery-to-watches conglomerate’s second-quarter results declared on Thursday. The stock has gained over 31 per cent in the past year and 22 per cent year-to-date, sharply outpacing the Nifty 50’s negative returns over the same periods. At current levels, Titan trades at a P/E of 61 times, commanding a significant premium to the broader market. Traded volume stood at 32.70 lakh shares, with total traded value crossing ₹1,608 crore by afternoon.

title: Titan surges 2.5% on strong Q2 results; brokerages divided on upside
